Title: GA: Logic Apps (Standard) adds support for .NET Framework extensibility in XSLT data.

Body.Content: Developers can now add .NET Framework methods to XSLT data transformations in Azure Logic Apps (Standard). This functionality accelerates a customer’s ability to move integration workloads from BizTalk Server and Integration Service Environments (ISE) to Azure Logic Apps (Standard) without the need to re-wire XSLT data transformations.
